svg.title: System profile — Yaswanth Kumar Akkireddy
svg.desc: Applied AI Engineer at Felix Byte Technologies; previously AI Red-Team Engineer at Aram Algorithm. Focus: agentic AI, RAG, multi-agent systems, LLM evaluation, AI reliability, red teaming. Stack: LangGraph, LangChain, MCP, FastAPI, Docker, PostgreSQL, RAGAS, PyTorch. Selected work: 4 flagship systems and 2 supporting projects. Evidence: 20/20 prompts in a single-model baseline and 37/37 expected Sakila fixture findings.
